title: Books of the Bible (66-book Protestant canon)
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Knowing the books in order makes it quick to find a passage, and it shows how the Bible is laid out: law, history, poetry, prophets, then the Gospels and letters. Families have learned this list by heart for generations, often as a song.

How to hold it: Sixty-six names is a long list, so chunk it by section. The sections are the meaningful units: five books of Law, twelve of History, five of Poetry and wisdom, five Major prophets, twelve Minor prophets, then the New Testament. Long sections are split into groups of about five. A tune helps too: sing each section to a melody you already know, and the rhythm carries the order.
This list has 66 items. Answer below, then check — the practice button generates fresh questions from the list itself.
